title: 第一章 不是一个世界的人第十三章 大熙真正的靠山
content_zh:
“萧凉，你只是下品灵根，我们不是一个世界的人，你我婚约就此作废，从今往后，各自安好！”
苏家厅堂上，一绿衣女子满脸孤傲决绝之色，声音里不带任何情感。
她身材玲珑有致，乌黑的长发，弯弯黛眉，明亮灵动的大眼睛，薄薄的丹唇，浑身上下透着一股清丽脱俗的气息，美丽明艳而不妖媚。
她，就是萧凉的未婚妻，苏继的掌上明珠苏雨涵，大熙京城有名的美人。
“苏雨涵，你好无情啊！”萧凉双眼泛红，双手捏得紧紧，指尖嵌入掌心，阵阵疼痛袭来，心中一阵苦涩。
灵根是沟通天地元气的桥梁，有下品、中品、上品、极品，神品之分。
没有灵根，注定一辈子只能是个平凡人。
就在今日，苏雨涵觉醒了极品灵根，而萧凉只是下品灵根，一个在天，一个在地。
“涵儿不要胡闹，婚约已经定下，岂能说作废就作废？这样外人如何看待你？如何看待我们苏家？”
苏继眼中泛起责怪之色，苏雨涵可是万中无一的极品灵根啊，这是苏家崛起的希望。
而萧凉却只有下品灵根，勉强能踏足修炼之路，注定一辈子碌碌无为，除却一张脸长得英俊之外，没有一点配得上苏雨涵的。
“苍鹰翱翔蓝天，扶摇直上九万里，而蚂蚁忙忙碌碌一生，终究走不过弹丸之地。”
“不是我不履行婚约，故意让您为难，让苏家被人议论，实在是我与萧凉有天壤之别，根本不可能的。”
“爹爹知道凌霄阁是何等地方，怎么会允许他们的天骄弟子有一个废物未婚夫？国师不会答应，皇上更不会答应。”
“所以，婚约作废，对萧凉只有好处，这也是在为他考虑。”
凌霄阁，无数天之骄子挤破脑袋都要进去的修炼圣地，大熙皇朝当朝国师洛行舟所建，上品灵根是进入的门槛，凡入凌霄阁者，前途无量。
苏雨涵看上去是在为萧凉考虑，实际上话里话外，都在用凌霄阁，用大熙国师来威胁萧凉。
苏继叹息一声，眼中泛起复杂之色，看向萧凉说道：“凉儿，涵儿的情况的确有些特殊，她如今得国师看重收为弟子，已入凌霄阁，你们两个的婚约恐怕有点变故。”
随即他一正身子，拍胸脯说道：“不过凉儿不要担心，当年我答应过你父亲会照顾好你，自然不会是食言。”
“有我在，有苏家在，凉儿定能一辈子平平安安！”

五年前荒国举三十万大军南侵，弱冠之年的镇北王临危受命，领兵十万迎敌。
苏继和萧凉父亲都是军中将士，当时萧凉父亲萧野乃镇北王军中副帅，谋略超群，用兵如神，苏继则是萧野手下得力将领，二人关系极好，情同手足。
惨烈大战中，萧野为救苏继挡下致命一击，而自己重伤油尽灯枯，再也回不来。
苏继为报萧凉父亲救命大恩，五年前将萧凉接到苏府来照顾，还把掌上明珠苏雨涵许配给了萧凉。
“所以，继叔是什么意思？”
萧凉暗暗叹息一声，眼中充满了彷徨，繁华热闹的人世间，他却是觉得无比的孤独。
他并不是这方世界的人，五年前自蓝星穿越而来，一直便一直住在这里。
content_en:
"Xiao Liang, you are just a low-grade spiritual root. We are not from the same world. The engagement between you and me is hereby cancelled. From now on, we can all be well!"
In the hall of the Su family, a woman in green clothes had a look of aloofness and determination on her face, and there was no emotion in her voice.
She has a slim figure, long black hair, curved eyebrows, big bright eyes, and thin red lips. She has an air of elegance and refinement all over her body. She is beautiful and bright but not coquettish.
She is Xiao Liang's fiancée, Su Ji's apple, Su Yuhan, a famous beauty in Daxi Capital.
"Su Yuhan, you are so heartless!" Xiao Liang's eyes turned red, and he squeezed his hands tightly, his fingertips embedded in his palms. Pain came over him, and he felt bitter in his heart.
Spiritual roots are the bridge that communicates the vitality of heaven and earth. They are divided into low grade, medium grade, top grade, top grade and divine grade.
Without spiritual roots, one is destined to remain an ordinary person for the rest of his life.
Just today, Su Yuhan awakened the top-grade spiritual roots, while Xiao Liang only had low-grade spiritual roots, one in the sky and one on the ground.
"Han'er, don't be ridiculous. The engagement has been made. How can it be invalidated just because it's invalid? How will outsiders view you? How will they view our Su family?"
There was a look of blame in Su Ji's eyes. Su Yuhan had the best spiritual root. This was the hope of the Su family's rise.
But Xiao Liang only had low-grade spiritual roots and could barely embark on the path of cultivation. He was doomed to live a life of inaction. Apart from a handsome face, there was nothing worthy of Su Yuhan.
"The goshawk soars into the blue sky, soaring ninety thousand miles, but the ant is busy all his life, and ultimately cannot reach a small place."
"It's not that I didn't fulfill my engagement and deliberately made things difficult for you and caused the Su family to be discussed. It's really that there is a world of difference between me and Xiao Liang, and it's simply impossible."
"Daddy knows what kind of place Lingxiao Pavilion is, how could he allow their talented disciple to have a good-for-nothing fiancé? The Imperial Master will not agree, and the Emperor will not agree."
"So, the annulment of the engagement is only good for Xiao Liang. This is also for his consideration."
Lingxiao Pavilion is a sacred place of cultivation that countless proud men of heaven have to squeeze their heads into. It was built by Luo Xingzhou, the current national master of the Daxi Dynasty. High-grade spiritual roots are the threshold for entry. Anyone who enters Lingxiao Pavilion will have a bright future.
Su Yuhan seemed to be thinking about Xiao Liang, but in fact, she was using Lingxiao Pavilion and Daxi Imperial Master to threaten Xiao Liang.
Su Ji sighed, with a complicated look in his eyes, and looked at Xiao Liang and said, "Liang'er, Han'er's situation is indeed a bit special. Now that she has been favored by the Imperial Master and accepted as a disciple, she has entered Lingxiao Pavilion. I'm afraid there may be some changes in your engagement."
Then he straightened up, patted his chest and said, "But don't worry, Liang'er. I promised your father that I would take good care of you back then, and I certainly won't break my promise."
"With me here and the Su family here, Liang'er will be safe for the rest of his life!"
Five years ago, the Huang Kingdom invaded the south with an army of 300,000 men. The King of Zhenbei, who was still in his weak years, was ordered to lead 100,000 troops to meet the enemy.
Su Ji and Xiao Liang's fathers were both lieutenant generals in the army. At that time, Xiao Liang's father Xiao Ye was the deputy commander of the Zhenbei King's army. He had excellent strategies and used troops like a god. Su Ji was Xiao Ye's capable general. The two had a very good relationship and were brothers.
In the tragic battle, Xiao Ye took a fatal blow to save Su Ji, but he was seriously injured and ran out of fuel, never to come back.
In order to repay Xiao Liang's father for saving his life, Su Ji brought Xiao Liang to the Su Mansion to take care of him five years ago. He also betrothed his beloved Su Yuhan to Xiao Liang.
"So, what does step-uncle mean?"
Xiao Liang sighed secretly, his eyes full of hesitation. In the bustling and bustling world, he felt extremely lonely.
He is not from this world. He traveled from Blue Star five years ago and has been living here ever since.
